title: Run the full plan and report every exclusion
advisorGate: S5A accepted; final batch plan plus nonzero-impact control approved 2026-09-27
question: Can a strict batch workflow preserve evidence, align impacts, and withhold a primary result for an incomplete plan?
model: Frozen trial IDs/order/condition, required declared acquisition metadata, SHA-256 admission, impact-relative single-mode fits through unchanged intake_v2; only all planned eligible trials produce primary contrast
controls: Complete16trial set with1s padded first trial correctly aligned
Composite invalid trials: silence, clipping, overlapping modes, wrong source hash
Wrong zero impact on padded file rejects silence
Existing output directory rejected without overwrite
limits: Complete dryrun is generated data, not an executed physical bench
Declared metadata and hashes establish neither authenticity nor physical calibration
Any surviving-trial contrast from an incomplete set is descriptive only
Recorded-channel effects retain the exact condition-linked gain rival fromS5A
No added research loop follows this final sound review
incomingEvidence: S5A balanced order corrected only declared order drift. The final workflow must preserve every raw trial and avoid silently replacing incomplete preregistered results with selected survivors.
